title: Audio Memo Played Event
description: The Agent Pad reported playback of the spoken reply on the device (phase started or ended). Reported by the pad itself through the upload proxy, so it is the only fact that proves the driver was actually spoken to. Part of the voice memo journey: correlationid = data.memo_id and ordering_key 'memo:<memo_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

memo_id.description: Journey id: uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 's3://holocene-auto/' + s3_key). Also the correlationid of this event and of the agent invocation command, so one correlationid query returns the whole journey.

reply_s3_key.description: Object key of the reply audio.

target_agent_id.description: Agent that produced the reply. Parsed from the reply object key.

phase.description: started = the audio element began playing; ended = it played to the end.

client_user_agent.description: User agent of the device that played it.

reply_age_ms.description: Milliseconds from the reply object being written until playback started.
